notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for independent ordinary attribute-value requests from two active requesters. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies shared object discovery and identity lookups, preserves each requester tag in separate provideAttributeValueUpdate callbacks, prevents provider-callback loopback to requesters, and verifies that the provider's ordinary response reaches both active subscribers with standard object, value, tag, producer, transportation, and no-region metadata. Timestamped delivery, regions/DDM, ownership, custom transportation, MOM, save/restore, and provider-private behavior remain outside this contract.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object-class lookup, publication, active subscription, object registration, object identity lookup, ordinary Request Attribute Value Update, ordinary Update Attribute Values, unsubscription, unpublication, resignation, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador discovery, provide-attribute-value-update, and reflect-attribute-values callbacks
